H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H130: an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H7586: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H288: Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1942: by implication, of falling); desire; also ruin
H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H8593: a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty)
H3913: properly, to hammer out (an edge), i.e. to sharpen
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H157: to have affection for (sexually or otherwise)
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H5331: properly, a goal, i.e. the bright object at adistance travelled towards; hence (figuratively), splendor, or (subjectively) truthfulness, or (objectively) confidence; but usually (adverbially), continually (i.e. to the most distant point of view)
H2846: to lay hold of; especially to pick up fire
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H8327: to root, i.e. strike into the soil, or (by implication) to pluck from it
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H7832: to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play
H1397: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H4581: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H2132: an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry
H7488: verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H6960: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
